review.evidence: Issue #534 explicitly references a bug (julia/issues/57223) introduced by the parsing change in #522. The description explains the incorrect behavior: when `$` has higher precedence than `->`, the parser cannot reliably look ahead at `->` in `parse_paren()`, causing incorrect tuple wrapping. The commit modifies `src/parser.jl` (production code) and `test/parser.jl` (test code), indicating both a fix and test evidence. The issue is clearly a regression/defect rather than a feature request.
